We've built the world's first event ticketing CLI for automating all the manual parts of running events, including operations. There's also an MCP server built in, so you can connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other tools. This is the first version. So far it can set up events, adjust settings, manage guest lists, bulk create promo codes and more. It'll keep getting more tools to handle event back office admin so your team increasingly delegate to agents. Please send us feature requests for both the CLI and the main Ticket Fairy platform.
